source.name: Parotid Atlas opening portrait skin map (pipeline/blender/skin.py): hero_orm.webp, occlusion, roughness and thickness (ORM)

attribution: Presentation only: authored skin maps baked in Blender Cycles onto the opening's figure; nothing photographic.
transformations: albedo: authored base tone, broad pigment, regional redness, beard shadow and stubble, lips, lids, lash line, nostrils, the scalp under the hair, freckles (procedural, seeded)
normal: the multires surface one level above the realtime mesh, with every shape edit, plus authored pores, fine skin texture, a millimetre-scale grain, forehead lines and stubble relief
ORM: baked ambient occlusion, authored regional roughness (T-zone, lips, beard, scalp) with pores and broad patches, thickness for the subsurface term (ears, nostrils, lids)
